name: Arabia
line: Arabia is a large, dry region of deserts and tribes southeast of Israel, known for trade and caravans, and where Paul went after meeting Jesus.

moments.title: A message against Arabia
moments.text: Isaiah spoke a burden against Arabia. He told the caravans of Dedanites to lodge in its thickets, and he said the glory of Kedar would be gone within a year.

moments.title: Paul goes into Arabia
moments.text: After God revealed His Son to him, Paul did not go to the apostles in Jerusalem. He went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

moments.title: Hagar and Mount Sinai
moments.text: Paul wrote that Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia. He used her as a picture of slavery, and he said believers are children of the free woman.
